principle_violations.reason: The AreaCalculator class manages both area calculations and shape storage, while the SumCalculator is responsible for formatting the output in different representations. Each class should ideally manage a single responsibility.
principle_violations.suggestion: Separate the area calculation logic into its own class, such as AreaManager, and have SumCalculator focus solely on output formatting.

principle_violations.reason: The AreaCalculator class must be modified to support new shapes, violating the open/closed principle. New shapes require changes to the existing code.
principle_violations.suggestion: Introduce a shape interface and separate classes for each shape type that implement a method to calculate their own area. The AreaManager then can iterate over these shapes without needing modification when new shape types are added.

overall_feedback: 2 principle violations found. Please see the details below.
